movie.title: The Get Out
movie.overview: A nightclub owner is on the verge of leaving his dangerous past behind for retirement with his girlfriend. When masked gunmen rob him and he finds himself squeezed by ruthless cartels, a mysterious newcomer arrives with an interest in buying the business. With danger closing in from all sides, he must navigate a deadly web of deception, power, and survival  -  where escape may no longer be an option.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Hoping for a peaceful retirement with his girlfriend, a nightclub owner with a dangerous past is dragged back into violence when cartels and a mysterious buyer threaten everything he has built.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A former criminal turned nightclub owner prepares to leave his violent past behind to start a quiet life with his girlfriend. However, his dreams of retirement are shattered when masked gunmen stage a brazen robbery, drawing the unwanted attention of ruthless cartels. Tensions escalate further with the arrival of a secretive newcomer eager to purchase the club. To protect his future and survive, he must navigate a treacherous maze of deception, betrayal, and deadly power struggles.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: A veteran nightclub owner stands on the brink of finally walking away from a life steeped in violence and crime. Desperate for a clean slate, he plans a peaceful retirement alongside his girlfriend, hoping his dark past remains behind him. That fragile hope shatters when a gang of masked gunmen violently robs his establishment, plunging his business into chaos. The fallout brings him into direct conflict with ruthless drug cartels, who begin squeezing him for control and restitution. As the pressure mounts, an enigmatic stranger unexpectedly arrives, offering to buy out the nightclub under suspicious circumstances. Suspicious of everyone around him, the owner tries to untangle the motives behind the robbery and the potential buyer's true agenda. With deadly enemies closing in from every angle, loyalties are tested and hidden secrets come to light. He realizes that stepping away will require surviving an increasingly hostile environment where every move could be fatal. Caught in a lethal crossfire of greed, vengeance, and survival, he must risk everything to secure his freedom before escape becomes impossible.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: In 'The Get Out', an action-thriller drama, a nightclub owner seeking a peaceful retirement with his girlfriend finds his plans derailed after a violent heist by masked gunmen. Squeezed between predatory cartels seeking dominance and a mysterious newcomer aiming to buy his business, he must navigate a web of deception and lethal threats where staying alive is the ultimate goal.

story_structure.climax: Tensions reach a boiling point in a high-stakes confrontation where the true motives of all parties collide, forcing him into a desperate battle for survival.
story_structure.conflict: A violent robbery by masked gunmen disrupts his plans, leaving him squeezed between ruthless cartels and facing a sudden, mysterious buyer interested in his club.
story_structure.resolution: The dust settles as the ultimate consequences of his choices unfold, determining whether he can truly escape his past or remain trapped by it.
story_structure.introduction: A nightclub owner plans to retire and leave his dangerous life behind with his girlfriend, hoping to secure a peaceful future.
story_structure.risingAction: As threats mount from all sides, he must navigate a web of deception, shifting power dynamics, and escalating danger while trying to protect his loved ones and find a way out.

characters.name: Manco Kapak (Russell Crowe)
characters.description: A nightclub owner with a violent criminal past who is trying to retire with his girlfriend, but gets forced into a dangerous game of survival when targeted by robbers and cartels.

characters.name: Joe Carver (Luke Evans)
characters.description: An undercover federal agent posing as a mysterious buyer interested in purchasing the nightclub to catch cartel leaders.

characters.name: Jeff (Aaron Paul)
characters.description: A college professor coerced by a corrupt cop into robbing Manco, setting off a wave of chaos.

characters.name: Carrie (Nina Dobrev)
characters.description: A thrill-seeking bank teller who blackmails Jeff into partnering with her to carry out armed heists.

characters.name: Sunny (Teresa Palmer)
characters.description: Manco's loyal girlfriend who wants to leave the city and start a peaceful new life with him abroad.

characters.name: Rodriguez (Daniel Zovatto)
characters.description: A ruthless cartel figure in Los Angeles who puts deadly pressure on Manco to settle financial debts.

characters.name: Irena (Kartiah Vergara)
characters.description: A woman caught in the middle of the cartel dispute who receives mercy from Manco.

characters.name: Sabelle Morrow-Woods
characters.description: A background character operating within the nightclub's surrounding criminal environment.
